name: seolith-tiles
description: Satisfying Micro-Tile Brick Breaker built with Rust (WASM), Three.js, and Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { fs.mkdirSync('public/wasm', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/seolith_engine.wasm', 'public/wasm/seolith_engine.wasm'); })"
